summary: Too easy for Today's list: every answer is a famous country, and a casual player gets all 10, losing lives only on China and Thailand. A good Blitz and an easy free-play roll.
reasons: Casual finds 10/10 in 12 guesses (lives lost on China and Thailand), fan 10/10 in 13. A harsher casual order still finds 9. The daily band is 6 to 8, and the crowd estimate averages about 6.8, above the owner's 5 to 6.
Flat curve: eight gimmes (France, Spain, US, Italy, UK, Germany, Japan, Mexico). Turkey at #4 and Greece at #10 are the only mild surprises, and there is no stretch answer.
China is the likeliest miss and costs a life with nothing shown: the world table has no 2024 figure for it. Thailand's miss works well (35.5, just under Greece's 36.0).
Blitz holds up: 20 of 26 quick guesses score. The dead ends (China, Australia, India, Switzerland, Croatia, Ireland) have no 2024 arrivals figure on the page.
Not fresh: it has been in random play since October (no debut flag), and the owner wants dailies nobody has seen.
fixes: China and Hong Kong cost a life with no figure and no reason given, and China is the most natural wrong guess (both simulated players lost a life on it). Keeping them out of the ranking is right: the world table has no 2024 figure for China, and the Asia table's 64.9 is China's exit-entry count of foreigners' trips (in and out), not arrivals. But the miss should say why, e.g. 'No 2024 UN figure for China'. That needs a per-entry miss note in the puzzle format (src/game/types.ts), which is the coordinator's call.

United Arab Emirates shows 18.72, but that is Dubai's count alone (the page's source: 'Dubai Welcomes 18.72 Million International Visitors (2024)'). Drop the figure (the UAE then stops scoring in Blitz) or use a UAE-wide 2024 figure.

The top-10 facts are generic country facts that repeat on other lists: Japan's mountainous terrain (co2-emissions, island-countries), the UK as first industrialised country (countries-gdp, f1-wins-by-country), France's 1789 Declaration (ballon-dor-countries), Germany's Reformation (co2-emissions). Write travel facts in scripts/facts/tourism.json, such as what draws the visitors.
